states.name: q
states.meaning: 16-bit packed BCD count: q[3:0]=ones, q[7:4]=tens, q[11:8]=hundreds, q[15:12]=thousands; valid BCD values represent decimal 0000 through 9999.
states.update_time: posedge clk, sampled after the edge settles; synchronous reset forces q to 0x0000

rules.condition: reset == 1 at the sampled posedge; synchronous active-high reset forces all four BCD digits to 0, q = 0x0000.

reset == 0 at the sampled posedge; q_next is the 4-digit BCD value q + 1 in decimal, wrapping from 9999 to 0000. In packed bits, update ones q[3:0], carry when a digit is 9, and roll over the 4-digit BCD count modulo 10000.

Combinational from current q: ena[0] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9; ena[1] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9 and q[7:4] == 9; ena[2] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9, q[7:4] == 9, and q[11:8] == 9. As an unsigned 3-bit integer with bit0=ena[1], bit1=ena[2], bit2=ena[3]: ena = ((q & 15)==9 ? 1 : 0) + (((q & 255)==0x99) ? 2 : 0) + (((q & 4095)==0x999) ? 4 : 0).
rules.spec_quote: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled posedge with reset == 0 after reset has been high; that edge performs the first increment from q == 0

before.mid: Optional mid changes occur after sampling and before the next edge; they are carried to the start of the next row. Since reset is the only nonclock input, a mid reset change affects the next sampled posedge.
